# KickPulse: full guide

> KickPulse is a free football (soccer) scores website: live scores, fixtures, results, league tables, match timelines, team statistics and lineups. Scores come from ESPN's public data feed and may be delayed. KickPulse is not affiliated with ESPN or any league or club.

Site: https://kickpulse-football.vercel.app/

## Premier League Live Scores Today | Results & Fixtures | KickPulse

- URL: https://kickpulse-football.vercel.app/premier-league-live-scores/
- What it is: Premier League live scores, results and fixtures today. Follow every match with goals, cards, stats and lineups on KickPulse.
- People search for: Premier League live score, Premier League table, Premier League fixtures today, Premier League results
- Images: https://kickpulse-football.vercel.app/assets/og-premier-league.jpg ; https://kickpulse-football.vercel.app/assets/img/premier-league-table-fixtures.jpg
- Image description: Premier League live score, table, fixtures and results on KickPulse

## Coverage notes

KickPulse covers leagues from the UK, Spain, Italy, Germany, France, Saudi Arabia and the USA, plus UEFA competitions, the FA Cup and the 2026 World Cup. Kick-off times are converted to the visitor's time zone. In the UK the sport is called football, in the USA and Canada it is often called soccer.
